meanings.en: the fact of having done something wrong, or the feeling of having done so
meanings.exampleEn: She felt a deep sense of guilt after lying to her friend.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşına yalan söyledikten sonra derin bir suçluluk duydu.

meanings.en: responsible for doing something wrong, or feeling ashamed about it
meanings.exampleEn: He felt guilty about forgetting her birthday.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun doğum gününü unuttuğu için suçlu hissetti.

meanings.en: a person who plays the guitar
meanings.exampleEn: The guitarist played a beautiful solo during the concert.
meanings.exampleTr: Gitarist konser sırasında güzel bir solo çaldı.

meanings.en: a building or room with equipment for physical exercise
meanings.exampleEn: I go to the gym three times a week to stay fit.
meanings.exampleTr: Formda kalmak için haftada üç kez spor salonuna giderim.

meanings.en: physical exercises and movements often performed in competition
meanings.exampleEn: She has practiced gymnastics since she was five years old.
meanings.exampleTr: Beş yaşından beri jimnastik yapıyor.

meanings.en: the natural environment where a plant or animal lives
meanings.exampleEn: Pollution is destroying the natural habitat of many animals.
meanings.exampleTr: Kirlilik birçok hayvanın doğal yaşam alanını yok ediyor.

meanings.en: a person whose job is to cut and style hair
meanings.exampleEn: My hairdresser gave me a great new haircut.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuaförüm bana harika yeni bir saç kesimi yaptı.

meanings.en: an electrical device that blows hot air to dry hair
meanings.exampleEn: She used a hairdryer to dry her hair quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Saçını çabucak kurutmak için saç kurutma makinesi kullandı.

meanings.en: to the extent of one of two equal parts; partly
meanings.exampleEn: The glass was half full of water.
meanings.exampleTr: Bardak yarıya kadar suyla doluydu.

meanings.en: a tool with a heavy metal head used for hitting nails
meanings.exampleEn: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiviyi duvara çakmak için bir çekiç kullandı.

meanings.en: small enough to be held and used in one hand
meanings.exampleEn: She recorded the video with a hand-held camera.
meanings.exampleTr: Videoyu elde taşınabilir bir kamerayla kaydetti.

meanings.en: a team sport in which players throw a ball into the other team's goal
meanings.exampleEn: Our school team won the handball championship.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul takımımız hentbol şampiyonasını kazandı.

meanings.en: a small square of cloth used for wiping the nose or face
meanings.exampleEn: He took out a handkerchief and wiped his forehead.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir mendil çıkardı ve alnını sildi.

meanings.en: the act of holding and shaking someone's hand as a greeting
meanings.exampleEn: They sealed the deal with a firm handshake.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşmayı sıkı bir el sıkışmayla mühürlediler.

meanings.en: the way a person writes with a pen or pencil
meanings.exampleEn: Her handwriting is so neat that it looks printed.
meanings.exampleTr: El yazısı o kadar düzgün ki basılmış gibi görünüyor.

meanings.en: attached at the top so as to hang down freely
meanings.exampleEn: A hanging lamp lit up the small kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Asılı bir lamba küçük mutfağı aydınlatıyordu.

meanings.en: a sheltered area of water where ships can stay safely
meanings.exampleEn: The fishing boats returned to the harbor at sunset.
meanings.exampleTr: Balıkçı tekneleri gün batımında limana döndü.

meanings.en: putting a lot of effort and energy into work
meanings.exampleEn: She is a hard-working student who never gives up.
meanings.exampleTr: O, asla pes etmeyen çalışkan bir öğrenci.

meanings.en: a situation that is difficult and causes suffering
meanings.exampleEn: The family endured great hardship during the war.
meanings.exampleTr: Aile savaş sırasında büyük bir zorluğa katlandı.

meanings.en: a set of straps used to control or hold something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: The climber attached the rope to her harness before climbing.
meanings.exampleTr: Tırmanıcı tırmanmadan önce ipi koşum takımına bağladı.

meanings.en: done quickly, often without enough thought or care
meanings.exampleEn: He later regretted his hasty decision to quit.
meanings.exampleTr: İşten ayrılma konusundaki aceleci kararından sonradan pişman oldu.

meanings.en: a small door or opening in a floor, wall, ship, or aircraft
meanings.exampleEn: The sailors closed the hatch before the storm hit.
meanings.exampleTr: Denizciler fırtına gelmeden önce ambar kapağını kapattılar.

meanings.en: a very strong feeling of dislike for someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: His speech was full of hatred toward his enemies.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşması düşmanlarına karşı nefretle doluydu.

meanings.en: a place that someone visits often
meanings.exampleEn: This little café was a favorite haunt of local artists.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu küçük kafe yerel sanatçıların gözde uğrak yeriydi.

meanings.en: a safe place where someone or something is protected
meanings.exampleEn: The quiet village was a haven for tired city workers.
meanings.exampleTr: Sessiz köy, yorgun şehir çalışanları için bir sığınaktı.

meanings.en: something that could be dangerous or cause harm
meanings.exampleEn: Wet floors are a serious hazard in the kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Islak zeminler mutfakta ciddi bir tehlikedir.

meanings.en: to become healthy again, or to make something healthy
meanings.exampleEn: The wound will heal in about two weeks.
meanings.exampleTr: Yara yaklaşık iki hafta içinde iyileşecek.

meanings.en: having the power to make someone or something healthy again
meanings.exampleEn: Many people believe in the healing power of nature.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok insan doğanın iyileştirici gücüne inanır.

meanings.en: the ability to hear sounds
meanings.exampleEn: His hearing got worse as he grew older.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlandıkça işitmesi kötüleşti.

meanings.en: a sudden, dangerous medical condition when the heart stops working properly
meanings.exampleEn: He suffered a heart attack and was rushed to the hospital.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalp krizi geçirdi ve aceleyle hastaneye götürüldü.

meanings.en: having a particular kind of character or feelings (used in combinations)
meanings.exampleEn: She is a kind-hearted woman who helps everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: O, herkese yardım eden iyi yürekli bir kadındır.

meanings.en: warm and friendly, or large and satisfying (of a meal)
meanings.exampleEn: They enjoyed a hearty breakfast before the long hike.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten önce doyurucu bir kahvaltı yaptılar.

meanings.en: a device that produces heat to warm a room or water
meanings.exampleEn: We turned on the heater because the room was cold.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda soğuk olduğu için ısıtıcıyı açtık.

meanings.en: in some religions, the place where God lives and good people go after death
meanings.exampleEn: She believed her grandmother was now in heaven.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannesinin artık cennette olduğuna inanıyordu.

meanings.en: relating to heaven, or extremely pleasant
meanings.exampleEn: The cake tasted absolutely heavenly.
meanings.exampleTr: Pasta gerçekten cennet gibi tadındaydı.

meanings.en: the back part of the foot below the ankle
meanings.exampleEn: My new shoes hurt my heel after the long walk.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni ayakkabılarım uzun yürüyüşten sonra topuğumu acıttı.

meanings.en: the measurement of how tall or high something or someone is
meanings.exampleEn: The height of the building is over two hundred meters.
meanings.exampleTr: Binanın yüksekliği iki yüz metreden fazladır.

meanings.en: a hard hat worn to protect the head
meanings.exampleEn: Always wear a helmet when you ride a bicycle.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisiklete bindiğinde her zaman kask tak.

meanings.en: unable to take care of oneself or to act
meanings.exampleEn: The injured bird looked helpless on the ground.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaralı kuş yerde çaresiz görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a large group of animals of the same type living together
meanings.exampleEn: A herd of cattle was grazing in the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir sığır sürüsü tarlada otluyordu.

meanings.en: to pause before doing something because of doubt or nervousness
meanings.exampleEn: Don't hesitate to ask me if you need any help.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardıma ihtiyacın olursa bana sormakta tereddüt etme.

meanings.en: kept out of sight or not easily noticed
meanings.exampleEn: They found a hidden room behind the bookshelf.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitaplığın arkasında gizli bir oda buldular.

meanings.en: to a high degree; very much
meanings.exampleEn: This book is highly recommended by teachers.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kitap öğretmenler tarafından son derece tavsiye ediliyor.

meanings.en: the area on each side of the body between the waist and the leg
meanings.exampleEn: She placed her hands on her hips and looked annoyed.
meanings.exampleTr: Ellerini kalçalarına koydu ve sinirli görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a person who studies or writes about history
meanings.exampleEn: The historian wrote a detailed book about ancient Rome.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarihçi antik Roma hakkında ayrıntılı bir kitap yazdı.

meanings.en: important in history or likely to be remembered
meanings.exampleEn: The signing of the treaty was a historic moment.
meanings.exampleTr: Antlaşmanın imzalanması tarihî bir andı.

meanings.en: connected with the past or with the study of history
meanings.exampleEn: The museum displays many historical documents.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze birçok tarihsel belge sergiliyor.

meanings.en: a virus that attacks the immune system and can cause AIDS
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors are working on better treatments for HIV.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar HIV için daha iyi tedaviler üzerinde çalışıyor.

meanings.en: connected with God or religion and deeply respected
meanings.exampleEn: Many pilgrims travel to this holy city every year.
meanings.exampleTr: Her yıl birçok hacı bu kutsal şehre seyahat eder.

meanings.en: having no home to live in
meanings.exampleEn: The charity provides meals for homeless people.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardım kuruluşu evsiz insanlara yemek sağlıyor.

meanings.en: telling the truth and not cheating or stealing
meanings.exampleEn: She is an honest person who never tells lies.
meanings.exampleTr: O, asla yalan söylemeyen dürüst bir insandır.

meanings.en: in a truthful way; used to emphasize that you are telling the truth
meanings.exampleEn: Honestly, I had no idea about the surprise party.
meanings.exampleTr: Açıkçası, sürpriz parti hakkında hiçbir fikrim yoktu.

meanings.en: the quality of being truthful and not cheating
meanings.exampleEn: Honesty is the most important value in a friendship.
meanings.exampleTr: Dürüstlük, bir arkadaşlıktaki en önemli değerdir.

meanings.en: a holiday taken by a couple after they get married
meanings.exampleEn: They went to Italy for their honeymoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Balayı için İtalya'ya gittiler.

meanings.en: a short jump, especially on one foot
meanings.exampleEn: The rabbit moved across the garden with a quick hop.
meanings.exampleTr: Tavşan hızlı bir sıçrayışla bahçeyi geçti.

meanings.en: feeling or showing hope that something good will happen
meanings.exampleEn: We are hopeful that the weather will improve tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Yarın havanın düzeleceği konusunda umutluyuz.

meanings.en: used to express that you hope something will happen
meanings.exampleEn: Hopefully, we will arrive before it gets dark.
meanings.exampleTr: Umarım hava kararmadan önce varırız.

meanings.en: without any hope of success or improvement
meanings.exampleEn: The situation seemed hopeless after the third failure.
meanings.exampleTr: Üçüncü başarısızlıktan sonra durum umutsuz görünüyordu.

meanings.en: the line where the sky seems to meet the land or sea
meanings.exampleEn: The sun slowly sank below the horizon.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş yavaşça ufkun altına battı.

meanings.en: a hard pointed part on an animal's head, or a device that makes a warning sound
meanings.exampleEn: The driver honked the horn to warn the pedestrians.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürücü yayaları uyarmak için kornaya bastı.

meanings.en: very unpleasant or bad
meanings.exampleEn: The weather was horrible during our whole trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm yolculuğumuz boyunca hava berbattı.

meanings.en: to make someone feel very shocked or disgusted
meanings.exampleEn: The news of the accident horrified the whole town.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazanın haberi tüm kasabayı dehşete düşürdü.

meanings.en: a place that provides cheap accommodation, often for travelers or students
meanings.exampleEn: We stayed in a youth hostel to save money.
meanings.exampleTr: Para biriktirmek için bir gençlik hostelinde kaldık.

meanings.en: all the people who live together in one house
meanings.exampleEn: The whole household helped to clean the garden.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm ev halkı bahçeyi temizlemeye yardım etti.

meanings.en: the work of cleaning and taking care of a home
meanings.exampleEn: We share the housework equally in our family.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailemizde ev işlerini eşit olarak paylaşırız.

meanings.en: extremely large in size or amount
meanings.exampleEn: They live in a huge house with ten bedrooms.
meanings.exampleTr: On yatak odalı kocaman bir evde yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: all people considered as a group, or the quality of being kind
meanings.exampleEn: New technology can benefit all of humanity.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni teknoloji tüm insanlığa fayda sağlayabilir.

meanings.en: having a lot of moisture in the air
meanings.exampleEn: The weather in summer is hot and humid here.
meanings.exampleTr: Burada yazın hava sıcak ve nemlidir.

meanings.en: the quality of being funny, or the ability to find things funny
meanings.exampleEn: She has a great sense of humor and makes everyone laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: Harika bir espri anlayışı var ve herkesi güldürüyor.

meanings.en: funny and able to make people laugh
meanings.exampleEn: He told a humorous story that made us laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: Bizi güldüren esprili bir hikaye anlattı.
